record.summary: Second-order MARGINALS on the supplied host are exact: pre_mean noise-corrected error <=0.0002 at every layer L2-15 (both ranks 35/201), pre_var grows ~1.3e-4 per layer to 0.0018 at L15 with median ratio 1.000 - unit-level scatter, no coherent drift; at final-output sensitivity ~0.5x that scatter is the same order as the entire remaining residual. Receipt written. Sign check: closure kappa5 crosses zero at k4 = (8/9) k3^2. Not wired (retrofit law); banked for oracle-frame accounting and clean-slate. SOLVED - THE ATTRIBUTION IS COMPLETE (FINAL_SENSITIVITY_RESULT.json + K5_MEASURED_RESULT.json, rank 35, 8M): at the L16 consumption the MEAN channel owns the output error (share 1.96 of dE MSE; var 0.21, k3 0.11, k4 only 0.05, remainder -1.33 anti-correlated), the consumption map at true inputs errs only 1.46e-5 RMS (2e-10-class MSE), and measured pre-k5 = 0.72-0.76x the closure - so the deep k4 decay is ~3/4 push-side projection loss but pays only ~5 percent at the output. THE REFRAME: the residual is the COMPOUNDED PER-STEP MEAN EMISSION BIAS (~0.1 percent/step), which retroactively explains all five co-adaptation refutations (they fixed a 5-percent-share channel while perturbing the mean channel). The paths that attack the mean channel directly: the micro-head (learned, running), the adjoint derivation (exact mean functional without forward-state perturbation), the exact ledger, quadrature.
